evidence: The repair branch preserves the existing Skill/domain structure and limits changes to evidence integrity, production safety routing, Web access control, installer safety, and documentation claims backed by concrete repository defects.

The historical green suite was decomposed into aggregate-runner integrity, evidence-target fidelity, production RiskDetector behavior, safety-route bypasses, server auth-path behavior, installer mutation behavior, and stale host/topology documentation instead of being accepted as one green claim.

Repair branch agent/aaop-pressure-real-repair currently points at 1eec9128706c8723b02d274166c40588aa0672fa and contains bounded candidate fixes plus direct regressions, but exact-head repository execution is still unavailable in the current host. Implementation presence is therefore not promoted into verified repair.

Targeted candidate logic was exercised before some remote mutations and the branch now contains runtime-sensitive safety, HTTP auth, and installer transaction regressions. The exact remote head has not yet run as a repository workspace, and GitHub-hosted Actions remain intentionally unused because monetary cost is not authorized.

After each repair slice the project was rescanned. Shadow tests exposed Runtime drift; safety routing exposed explicit/direct-module bypasses; auth exposed fail-open paths; installer exposed host guessing and destructive force semantics; README recovery proved a documented cross-repository workflow topology had already disappeared on both sides. Dependent Runtime mutation was then bounded instead of being stacked indefinitely.
